svg.title: My commits to the visitabudhabi.ae front end
svg.desc: Selected commits from 186 to the visitabudhabi.ae front end since February 2026: 2026-08-12 feat: Shareable chat sessions with share tokens; 2026-07-26 fix: Keyboard and screen-reader users couldn't operate parts of the chat; 2026-07-26 perf: Memoize BotMessage and ChatCarousel, stabilise keys; 2026-07-26 refactor: Extract sendMessageToApi into a useChatStream hook; 2026-07-24 fix: Tear down the SSE stream and timers on unmount; 2026-07-24 fix: Never send an authenticated message with a null user_id; 2026-07-13 fix: GTM data layer for the Ask Abu Dhabi chatbot; 2026-06-18 feat: Create an itinerary from a chat card; map markers fixed; 2026-06-12 fix: Chat map not showing on deployed servers; 2026-02-16 feat: Add the chatbot to visitabudhabi.ae.
svg.text: Shareable chat sessions with share tokens
Keyboard and screen-reader users couldn't operate parts of the chat
Memoize BotMessage and ChatCarousel, stabilise keys
Extract sendMessageToApi into a useChatStream hook
Tear down the SSE stream and timers on unmount
Never send an authenticated message with a null user_id
GTM data layer for the Ask Abu Dhabi chatbot
Create an itinerary from a chat card; map markers fixed
Chat map not showing on deployed servers
Selected from 186 commits, Feb to Aug 2026. The full log lives in a private client repo.
